pages.title: Ember — Wood-fire kitchen & bar in Lower Parel, Mumbai
pages.description: Coastal and Frontier food cooked over charcoal and mango wood, with a cocktail bar. Kamala Mills, Lower Parel. Book a table online.

sections.headline: Cooked over *fire*
sections.lede: Charcoal, mango wood and a kitchen with no gas line. Coastal and Frontier food, a long bar, and a room that stays warm until 1 am.

sections.text: There is no gas in our kitchen. Everything — the bread, the fish, the *dal* — touches flame.

sections.title: Take a *seat*
sections.text: Book a table for up to six, or the eight-seat chef's counter. For larger groups, message us on WhatsApp.

items.a: Yes, paid parking inside Kamala Mills, and valet from 8 pm on weekends.
About half the menu is vegetarian, marked with a green dot. Our kitchen cooks vegetarian food on separate grills.
Smart casual. We'd just like you to be comfortable.
